coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: OBOI 鼇拜, d. 1669, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, was the third son of Uici 偉齊, one of the members of the important Solgo family of the Gûwalgiya clan. In 1634, in return for his military services, he was, granted an hereditary commission as niru i janggin (captain of a company) and appointed to the position of colonel.
鼇拜，瓜爾佳氏，滿州鑲黄旗人，衛齊第三子。

accounts.evidence: 鼇拜，瓜爾佳氏，滿州鑲黄旗人，衛齊第三子。初以巴牙喇壯達從征，屢有功。
